parole.significato: jujube; any of several trees in the genus Ziziphus of the buckthorn family, especially Ziziphus jujuba
parole.testo: Borrowed from French jujube (“jujube”), ultimately from Vulgar Latin *zizūpus (“jujube”), probably transmitted through Old Occitan or Occitan, although no corresponding Occitan form of the jujube type is attested.
